# Desktop parts: dock, wallpaper, screens, panes

<!-- Generated by dist/sdk/gen-widget-docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

What the shell gives an app about its place: arrangement, dock port, wallpaper port, status.

## `desktop`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/desktop.rs`)

The desktop parts an app can see: screens (outputs), views (named layouts of panes), panes, the dock and the wallpaper.
The dock and the wallpaper are reached through the ports [`DockPort`] and [`WallpaperPort`]: an SDK app never writes a file or talks to
the shell itself (the core rule). The shell side of each port goes through the core, which asks permission and logs; the in-memory
implementations here are what tests and the browser preview use.

### struct `Arrangement`

The screens, and the per-screen choices of dock and wallpaper.

```rust
pub struct Arrangement
```

Methods:

- `pub fn new(mut screens: Vec<Screen>) -> Arrangement`: At least one screen; the first primary one stays primary (or the first screen becomes it).
- `pub fn single(w: u32, h: u32) -> Arrangement`
- `pub fn screens(&self) -> &[Screen]`
- `pub fn primary(&self) -> &Screen`
- `pub fn resolve(&self, id: u32) -> &Screen`: The screen with this id; a screen that was unplugged answers with the primary one, so a pane is never left without a screen.
- `pub fn screen_at(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> Option<&Screen>`
- `pub fn unplug(&mut self, id: u32) -> bool`: Unplug a screen. The last screen cannot be removed. Its dock and wallpaper choices go with it.
- `pub fn dock_for(&self, look: &Look, screen: u32) -> DockPos`: The dock of a screen: the person's own choice for it, else the Look's position on the primary screen and **off** on any other (decision 2026-11-15: one dock per screen, off by default on secondary screens).
- `pub fn set_dock(&mut self, screen: u32, pos: DockPos)`
- `pub fn wallpaper_for(&self, look: &Look, screen: u32) -> wallpaper::Id`: The wallpaper of a screen: its own choice, else the Look's.
- `pub fn set_wallpaper(&mut self, screen: u32, id: wallpaper::Id)`

### struct `Pane`

Where an app is drawn right now: on which screen, in which view, how big (logical units). Moving the pane to another view or screen,
or resizing it, changes this and the host sends `UiEvent::Resized`.

```rust
pub struct Pane
```

Public fields:

- `pub screen: u32`
- `pub view: String`
- `pub w: f32`
- `pub h: f32`

### enum `DeskError`

```rust
pub enum DeskError
```

Variants:

- `NotAllowed`: The person's policy does not let this person use that app.
- `UnknownApp`
- `Refused(String)`: The core refused (a card was declined, the capability is not granted).
- `Unavailable`: This host has no such part (a browser preview without a dock).

### fn `text_over_wallpaper`

The colour for text drawn straight on a wallpaper: the Look's text colour when it reads (4.5:1) on that wallpaper, else black or
white, whichever reads better. (Wallpapers are judged by their light/dark flag and a representative colour.)

```rust
pub fn text_over_wallpaper(look: &Look, id: wallpaper::Id) -> [u8; 4]
```
